SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN category='Operating expense' THEN amount WHEN category='Income tax expense' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END) FROM adjustments WHERE period_end='2024-11-30' AND months=3

SELECT (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-11-30' AND months=3 AND measure='Net income') + (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN category='Operating expense' THEN amount WHEN category='Income tax expense' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END) FROM adjustments WHERE period_end='2024-11-30' AND months=3)

SELECT ((SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-11-30' AND months=3 AND measure='Net income') + (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN category='Operating expense' THEN amount WHEN category='Income tax expense' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END) FROM adjustments WHERE period_end='2024-11-30' AND months=3)) * 100.0 / (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-11-30' AND months=3 AND measure='Total revenues')
